context_requirements: Cells must be proliferating and have intact DNA damage response signaling (e.g., TP53 or equivalent) for robust transcriptional response.
Drug must be taken up and metabolized to active DNA-damaging species; CYP2C9/CYP3A4 expression may influence activation.
Cell lines with defective DNA repair or checkpoint pathways may show altered kinetics or magnitude.
falsifiers: No induction of CDKN1A, GADD45A, or other p53 targets at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line.
No repression of cell-cycle genes (e.g., CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1) at 24 h.
Lack of dose-dependent or time-dependent transcriptional changes across all nine lines.
Predominant upregulation of proliferation genes rather than DNA damage response.
